name: Kuala Lumpur
summary: Kuala Lumpur is the silent hub of Southeast Asia. Ultra-fast internet, moderate cost of living, modern infrastructure, excellent transport and a perfect geographical position as a base to explore the entire region. English is official and is spoken everywhere.
strengths: Low cost of livingEUR 559/month — 35% below the average of the 90 cities
considerations: Safety below averageSafety index 4.1/10 compared to an average of 5.9/10
